column1: # Classes for tools/fwsrc.py: `addr class name`. The function at addr (named name in
# symbols.tsv), up to the next function entry, goes to <class>.s instead of its files.tsv
# file, and its C++ conversion to private/cpp/<class>.cpp (docs/source-build.md *Classes*).
# Stock code interleaves classes inside a compile unit, so a class file holds several
# sections, which the linker puts back in stock order.
# Class names come from the vtables (vt_<class> in symbols.tsv); a function is listed when
# its name starts with its class name. Functions not listed stay in their files.tsv file.
